passages.text: The project meeting is scheduled for 14 March 2027 at 09:00 at the Nairobi office.
The monthly service fee is KSh 150. Payment is due by the fifth day of each month.
Full-time staff receive 21 working days of annual leave. Submit a request at least 14 calendar days before leave begins.
Orders are delivered within three business days after payment confirmation.
Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00 East Africa Time.
